newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Some rail offers up on exports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Some rail offers up on exports.

text.p: Some rail soymeal offers were up Wednesday in response to talk of export business, and truck offers were mostly unchanged, dealers said.
"It's pretty quiet, but there's been a steady trickle of export business," one river dealer said.
There was also talk on the CBOT trading floor that the Philippines, Thailand and Indonesia were all in the market for Indian soymeal, a CBOT trader said.
Reports from Indonesia show between 40,000 to 60.000 tonnes of Indian soymeal were booked last week at prices ranging from $300 to $310 per tonne, traders there said.

In the domestic soymeal market, dealers reported that 20 railcars of soymeal were traded out of Danville, Ill. to Georgia on Tuesday at $10.00 per tonne over CBOT March futures. Shipment was slated for February, dealers said.
Several truck soymeal dealers said their markets were firm because domestic demand remained sound.
